## Start Here

Overview, installation, a first PDF and the architecture of the library.

- [Haru.NET Documentation](INDEX.md) - Haru.NET is a comprehensive, cross-platform PDF generation library for .NET 8 and later.
- [Quick Start Guide](USAGE.md) - Installing the package, the basic concepts and the most common tasks in short examples.
- [Getting Started with Haru.NET](guides/GettingStarted.md) - This tutorial will walk you through creating your first PDF document with Haru.NET.
- [Library Architecture](STRUCTURE.md) - Haru.NET is organized around a clean, hierarchical architecture that mirrors the PDF specification while providing a developer-friendly API.

## Guides

Task-oriented tutorials with runnable examples.

- [Fonts Guide](guides/FontsGuide.md) - This guide explains which fonts Haru.NET can use, how to load each kind, which character sets they cover and how to choose between them.
- [Text Guide](guides/TextGuide.md) - This guide shows how to put text on a page.
- [Graphics Guide](guides/GraphicsGuide.md) - This guide shows how to draw vector graphics on a PDF page.
- [Images Guide](guides/ImagesGuide.md) - This guide shows how to put pictures into a PDF.

- [Annotations Guide](guides/AnnotationsGuide.md) - This guide shows how to add sticky notes and links to a PDF.
- [Outlines Guide](guides/OutlinesGuide.md) - This guide shows how to add bookmarks (outlines) to a PDF.
- [Encryption Guide](guides/EncryptionGuide.md) - This guide shows how to protect a PDF with passwords.

## Core Classes

Documents, pages, fonts, images and the document-level objects (namespace `Haru.Doc`, fonts in `Haru.Font`).

- [HpdfDocument Class](api/core/HpdfDocument.md) - `HpdfDocument` is the main entry point for creating PDF documents with Haru.NET.
- [HpdfPage Class](api/core/HpdfPage.md) - `HpdfPage` represents a single page in a PDF document.
- [HpdfFont Class](api/core/HpdfFont.md) - `HpdfFont` is a unified wrapper for all font types in Haru.NET.
- [HpdfImage Class](api/core/HpdfImage.md) - `HpdfImage` represents an image XObject: picture data stored once in the PDF file and drawn on any number of pages, at any position and size.
- [HpdfCatalog Class](api/core/HpdfCatalog.md) - `HpdfCatalog` is the document catalog (`/Type /Catalog`), the root object of a PDF file.
- [HpdfDestination Class](api/core/HpdfDestination.md) - `HpdfDestination` is an explicit destination: a page of the document together with a view (position and zoom) that a viewer jumps to.
- [HpdfExtGState Class](api/core/HpdfExtGState.md) - `HpdfExtGState` is an extended graphics state dictionary (`/Type /ExtGState`).
- [HpdfInfo Class](api/core/HpdfInfo.md) - `HpdfInfo` is the document information dictionary (`/Info` in the file trailer).
- [HpdfOutline Class](api/core/HpdfOutline.md) - `HpdfOutline` is an entry of the document outline, the tree of bookmarks that viewers show in their navigation panel.
- [HpdfPageLabel Class](api/core/HpdfPageLabel.md) - `HpdfPageLabel` describes the page numbering of a range of pages.
- [HpdfPages Class](api/core/HpdfPages.md) - `HpdfPages` is a node of the page tree (`/Type /Pages`): the structure through which a PDF file lists its pages.

## Drawing and Text (Extension Methods)

The operations you call on a page.

- [HpdfPageGraphics Class](api/extensions/HpdfPageGraphics.md) - `HpdfPageGraphics` provides the vector drawing operations of Haru.NET.
- [HpdfPageShapes Class](api/extensions/HpdfPageShapes.md) - `HpdfPageShapes` adds circles, ellipses and arcs to the current path.
- [HpdfPageText Class](api/extensions/HpdfPageText.md) - `HpdfPageText` is a static class with extension methods for HpdfPage that write text to the page content stream.
- [HpdfDocumentExtensions Class](api/extensions/HpdfDocumentExtensions.md) - `HpdfDocumentExtensions` is a static class of extension methods for HpdfDocument that mirror functions of the C library.
- [HpdfPageExtensions Class](api/extensions/HpdfPageExtensions.md) - `HpdfPageExtensions` is a static class of convenience extension methods for HpdfPage, most of them named after functions of the C library.

## Forms

Interactive form fields and their widgets (namespaces `Haru.Forms`, `Haru.Forms.Appearance`).

- [HpdfAcroForm Class](api/forms/HpdfAcroForm.md) - `HpdfAcroForm` is the interactive form (AcroForm) of a document.
- [HpdfField Class](api/forms/HpdfField.md) - `HpdfField` is the abstract base class of all form fields.
- [HpdfTextField Class](api/forms/HpdfTextField.md) - `HpdfTextField` is a form field (`/FT /Tx`) into which the user types text: a single line, several lines (multiline) or a masked password.
- [HpdfCheckbox Class](api/forms/HpdfCheckbox.md) - `HpdfCheckbox` is a button field (`/FT /Btn`) with two states: checked (`Yes`) and unchecked (`Off`).
- [HpdfRadioButton Class](api/forms/HpdfRadioButton.md) - `HpdfRadioButton` is a radio button group: one button field (`/FT /Btn` with the `Radio` flag) whose options are widgets.
- [HpdfChoice Class](api/forms/HpdfChoice.md) - `HpdfChoice` is a choice field (`/FT /Ch`) that lets the user pick from a list of options.
- [HpdfSignature Class](api/forms/HpdfSignature.md) - `HpdfSignature` is an **unsigned** signature field (`/FT /Sig`).
- [HpdfWidgetAnnotation Class](api/forms/HpdfWidgetAnnotation.md) - `HpdfWidgetAnnotation` is the visible part of a form field: a rectangle on a page where the field is shown and edited.
- [ButtonElementType Enum](api/forms/ButtonElementType.md) - `ButtonElementType` selects the kind of button appearance that HpdfWidgetAnnotation.SetButtonAppearances() and HpdfAppearanceFactory.CreateAppearance() produce.
- [HpdfAppearanceFactory Class](api/forms/HpdfAppearanceFactory.md) - `HpdfAppearanceFactory` is a static class that creates the button appearance generators (IElementAppearance).
- [HpdfCheckboxAppearance Class](api/forms/HpdfCheckboxAppearance.md) - `HpdfCheckboxAppearance` draws the appearance of a checkbox.
- [HpdfFieldAlignment Enum](api/forms/HpdfFieldAlignment.md) - `HpdfFieldAlignment` is the horizontal alignment of the text in a form field (the quadding entry `/Q`).
- [HpdfFieldFlags Enum](api/forms/HpdfFieldFlags.md) - `HpdfFieldFlags` is a set of bit flags (`[Flags]`) that control the behavior of a form field: read-only, required, multiline, password, combo box and so on.
- [HpdfFieldType Enum](api/forms/HpdfFieldType.md) - `HpdfFieldType` is the type of a form field, written as the field type entry `/FT` of the field dictionary.
- [HpdfRadioButtonAppearance Class](api/forms/HpdfRadioButtonAppearance.md) - `HpdfRadioButtonAppearance` draws the appearance of a radio button: a circular frame, and in the "on" state a black filled circle (the dot) in its center.
- [HpdfWidgetFrame Class](api/forms/HpdfWidgetFrame.md) - `HpdfWidgetFrame` is a static class that draws the frame of a form field widget.
- [IElementAppearance Interface](api/forms/IElementAppearance.md) - `IElementAppearance` is the interface of the generators that draw button appearances.

## Annotations

Notes and links (namespace `Haru.Annotations`).

- [HpdfAnnotation Class](api/annotations/HpdfAnnotation.md) - `HpdfAnnotation` is the base class of all annotations: objects placed on a page in addition to its content, such as sticky notes, links and form field widgets.
- [HpdfLinkAnnotation Class](api/annotations/HpdfLinkAnnotation.md) - `HpdfLinkAnnotation` is a clickable area on a page.
- [HpdfTextAnnotation Class](api/annotations/HpdfTextAnnotation.md) - `HpdfTextAnnotation` is a sticky note: a small icon on the page that opens a pop-up window with a text when the reader clicks it.
- [HpdfAnnotationIcon Enum](api/annotations/HpdfAnnotationIcon.md) - `HpdfAnnotationIcon` selects the icon a viewer shows for a sticky note (HpdfTextAnnotation).
- [HpdfAnnotationType Enum](api/annotations/HpdfAnnotationType.md) - `HpdfAnnotationType` names the kind of an annotation; it is the value of HpdfAnnotation.Type and determines the `/Subtype` written to the annotation dictionary.
- [HpdfBorderStyle Enum](api/annotations/HpdfBorderStyle.md) - `HpdfBorderStyle` is the style of the border drawn around an annotation.
- [HpdfHighlightMode Enum](api/annotations/HpdfHighlightMode.md) - `HpdfHighlightMode` is the visual feedback a viewer gives while the mouse button is pressed on a link or a form field widget.

## Types and Enumerations

Value types, page sizes, enums and constants (namespace `Haru.Types`, page sizes in `Haru.Doc`).

- [HpdfRect Struct](api/types/HpdfRect.md) - `HpdfRect` is a rectangle given by its four edges in PDF user space units (points, 1/72 inch), measured from the lower-left corner of the page.
- [HpdfBox Struct](api/types/HpdfBox.md) - `HpdfBox` is a rectangle given by its four edges (left, bottom, right, top) in points.
- [HpdfPoint Struct](api/types/HpdfPoint.md) - `HpdfPoint` is a point in two-dimensional PDF user space (X and Y in points).
- [HpdfTransMatrix Struct](api/types/HpdfTransMatrix.md) - `HpdfTransMatrix` is a 2D transformation matrix `[a b c d x y]` as used by the PDF operators `cm` (current transformation matrix) and `Tm` (text matrix).
- [HpdfRgbColor Struct](api/types/HpdfRgbColor.md) - `HpdfRgbColor` holds an RGB color with components from 0.0 to 1.0.
- [HpdfCmykColor Struct](api/types/HpdfCmykColor.md) - `HpdfCmykColor` holds a CMYK color (cyan, magenta, yellow, black) with components from 0.0 to 1.0.
- [HpdfDashMode Struct](api/types/HpdfDashMode.md) - `HpdfDashMode` describes a line dash pattern: up to eight lengths of alternating dashes and gaps, plus a phase (how far into the pattern the line starts).
- [HpdfPageSize Enum](api/types/HpdfPageSize.md) - `HpdfPageSize` selects one of twelve predefined paper sizes for a page.
- [HpdfPageDirection Enum](api/types/HpdfPageDirection.md) - `HpdfPageDirection` chooses the orientation of a predefined HpdfPageSize: portrait keeps the paper's width and height, landscape swaps them.
- [HpdfPageSizes Class](api/types/HpdfPageSizes.md) - `HpdfPageSizes` is a static helper that turns a predefined HpdfPageSize and an HpdfPageDirection into a width and height in points.
- [Hpdf3DMatrix Struct](api/types/Hpdf3DMatrix.md) - `Hpdf3DMatrix` is a 3D transformation matrix of twelve numbers: a 3 x 3 rotation/scale part (`A` to `I`, row by row) and a translation (`Tx`, `Ty`, `Tz`).
- [HpdfBlendMode Enum](api/types/HpdfBlendMode.md) - `HpdfBlendMode` selects how colors that are painted are combined with the colors already on the page (the PDF blend mode).
- [HpdfColorSpace Enum](api/types/HpdfColorSpace.md) - `HpdfColorSpace` names the PDF color spaces.
- [HpdfCompressionMode Enum](api/types/HpdfCompressionMode.md) - `HpdfCompressionMode` is a set of flags (`[Flags]`, underlying type `uint`) that selects which content of the document is compressed with the Flate (zlib/deflate) filter.
- [HpdfConst Class](api/types/HpdfConst.md) - `HpdfConst` is a static class of constants carried over from `hpdf_consts.h` of the C library.
- [HpdfCountry Class](api/types/HpdfCountry.md) - `HpdfCountry` is a static class of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, a subset of the `HPDF_COUNTRY_...` constants of the C library.
- [HpdfDate Struct](api/types/HpdfDate.md) - `HpdfDate` holds a date and time with an optional time zone offset, field by field, like `HPDF_Date` of the C library.
- [HpdfEncryptMode Enum](api/types/HpdfEncryptMode.md) - `HpdfEncryptMode` selects the revision of the PDF standard security handler used to encrypt a document, which determines the algorithm and key length.
- [HpdfLang Class](api/types/HpdfLang.md) - `HpdfLang` is a static class of ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes, a subset of the `HPDF_LANG_...` constants of the C library.
- [HpdfLineCap Enum](api/types/HpdfLineCap.md) - `HpdfLineCap` is the shape drawn at the ends of open subpaths when they are stroked (the PDF line cap style).
- [HpdfLineJoin Enum](api/types/HpdfLineJoin.md) - `HpdfLineJoin` is the shape drawn at the corners where two segments of a stroked path meet (the PDF line join style).
- [HpdfPageLayout Enum](api/types/HpdfPageLayout.md) - `HpdfPageLayout` tells the viewer how to arrange pages when the document is opened: one page at a time, a continuous column, or two pages side by side.
- [HpdfPageMode Enum](api/types/HpdfPageMode.md) - `HpdfPageMode` tells the viewer which panel to show, or whether to go full screen, when the document is opened.
- [HpdfPageNumStyle Enum](api/types/HpdfPageNumStyle.md) - `HpdfPageNumStyle` is the numbering style of a page label range.
- [HpdfPermission Enum](api/types/HpdfPermission.md) - `HpdfPermission` is a set of flags (`[Flags]`, underlying type `uint`) that controls what a user who opens an encrypted document with the **user** password may do.
- [HpdfPoint3D Struct](api/types/HpdfPoint3D.md) - `HpdfPoint3D` is a point in three-dimensional space (X, Y and Z).
- [HpdfTextAlignment Enum](api/types/HpdfTextAlignment.md) - `HpdfTextAlignment` selects how `TextRect` places each line of text inside its rectangle: flush left, flush right, centered, or justified to both edges.
- [HpdfTextRenderingMode Enum](api/types/HpdfTextRenderingMode.md) - `HpdfTextRenderingMode` decides whether glyphs of shown text are filled, stroked, both, made invisible, and whether they are added to the clipping path (the PDF text rendering mode).
- [HpdfTextWidth Struct](api/types/HpdfTextWidth.md) - `HpdfTextWidth` holds the results of a text measurement: number of characters, words and spaces, and the text width.
- [HpdfTransitionStyle Enum](api/types/HpdfTransitionStyle.md) - `HpdfTransitionStyle` is the visual effect a viewer uses when it moves to a page in a presentation (full-screen slide show).
- [HpdfViewerPreferences Enum](api/types/HpdfViewerPreferences.md) - `HpdfViewerPreferences` is a set of flags (`[Flags]`, combine them with `|`) that tells the viewer how to present the document window.
- [HpdfWritingMode Enum](api/types/HpdfWritingMode.md) - `HpdfWritingMode` tells in which direction a font writes: from left to right, or from top to bottom as Chinese, Japanese and Korean text can be written.
- [Reserved Types](api/types/ReservedTypes.md) - The enums on this page were carried over from the Haru C library for completeness.
